opening_press_reference.value: A New Museum in Rotterdam Will Explore Global Migration Through the Lens of Art

offices.opening_description: Fenix museum in Rotterdam is set to open in May 2025, focusing on global migration through art. The museum will be housed in a transformed 16,000-square-meter warehouse, designed by MAD Architects, and will serve as a cultural hub in the regenerated Katendrecht district.
